1940.description: This update focuses on enhancing the user experience and expanding our integration capabilities. With improved error handling, more intuitive UI elements, and additional connectors for popular data sources, Crestone continues to evolve as a comprehensive solution for managing complex data pipelines with ease and efficiency.

news.description: Crestone enhances the SAP HANA source configuration experience with schema-aware object discovery and an improved search workflow. Users can now browse and select schemas before searching, and discover Tables, Views, and Calculation Views directly from the interface. This release also introduces object type badges, smarter search validation, automatic cleanup of dependent selections when schemas change, and improved loading states for a more intuitive and reliable configuration process.

1930.description: This update focuses on enhancing the user experience and expanding our integration capabilities. With improved error handling, more intuitive UI elements, and additional connectors for popular data sources, Crestone continues to evolve as a comprehensive solution for managing complex data pipelines with ease and efficiency.

news.description: Crestone now supports Single Sign-On (SSO) with Microsoft and Azure Active Directory accounts, allowing users to authenticate using their organization's existing credentials. Users can sign in directly from the login screen through Microsoft's authentication portal, reducing password management while leveraging corporate security policies. This release also includes improvements to authentication, session management, environment configuration, deployment portability, and startup behavior.

1920.description: This update focuses on enhancing the user experience and expanding our integration capabilities. With improved error handling, more intuitive UI elements, and additional connectors for popular data sources, Crestone continues to evolve as a comprehensive solution for managing complex data pipelines with ease and efficiency.

news.title_slide: SQL Server & Azure SQL Server Data Sources
news.description: Crestone now supports SQL Server and Azure SQL Server as data sources, allowing users to extract tables and views with support for both full and incremental loads when available. This release also introduces a guided visual configuration experience, enabling users to browse databases, schemas, tables, and columns directly from the interface, with improved loading indicators for a smoother setup process.

Crestone now supports SAP HANA as a destination for extracted data, with support for both full and incremental loads when available. This update introduces a clearer and more flexible configuration experience, allowing users to manage schemas and tables directly from the interface, including creating new schemas or tables, selecting existing ones, and preserving saved configurations when editing destinations.

This release introduces multiple usability and configuration enhancements across Crestone. New features include SQL Script Mode for custom query creation, preview support for SQL Server and Azure SQL Server sources, improved table search for ABAP and SAP S/4HANA, a clearer BAPI configuration experience, and cleaner pagination for large node lists. Together, these updates provide a more flexible, stable, and user-friendly experience during data extraction and node configuration workflows.

1897.description: This update focuses on enhancing the user experience and expanding our integration capabilities. With improved error handling, more intuitive UI elements, and additional connectors for popular data sources, Crestone continues to evolve as a comprehensive solution for managing complex data pipelines with ease and efficiency.

news.description: This update enhances the OData extraction experience by adding support for attachments with selectable target storage, improving URL configuration readability, and optimizing connection validation. It also includes pagination stability improvements and internal adjustments that ensure more consistent execution and better overall performance during OData extraction flows.

Several internal optimizations were implemented to improve the reliability and consistency of the extraction process. These enhancements focus on better integration between connection setup, execution flow, and destination handling, providing a more stable and efficient user experience.

1896.description: Over the last few weeks we’ve been steadily expanding what you can do with Crestone, and this update brings another set of powerful improvements. The platform is becoming an even stronger hub for managing end-to-end data pipelines: SAP extractions run more efficiently, SQL Server On Premise is easier to plug in as a destination, and you gain greater flexibility and control over how data is written and maintained across your environments.

news.description: Crestone now includes native integration with Microsoft Fabric OneLake, enabling organizations to connect and manage pipelines directly within their Microsoft Fabric environments. This update introduces simplified OneLake connection setup, automatic folder discovery inside lakehouses, and intuitive destination selection within node configurations, allowing teams to streamline storage management and accelerate data integration workflows.

The Google BigQuery integration has also been enhanced with intelligent SAP metadata interpretation and native data type mapping. With automatic schema generation and improved handling of date and time fields, Crestone now delivers cleaner, analytics-ready datasets in BigQuery while reducing manual adjustments and improving overall data quality.

189.description: Over the last few weeks we’ve been steadily expanding what you can do with Crestone, and this update brings another set of powerful improvements. The platform is becoming an even stronger hub for managing end-to-end data pipelines: SAP extractions run more efficiently, SQL Server On Premise is easier to plug in as a destination, and you gain greater flexibility and control over how data is written and maintained across your environments.

news.title_slide: CDC Tables in SAP ABAP – Faster, Smarter Loads
news.description: Crestone now supports Change Data Capture (CDC) on SAP ABAP tables — extracting only inserts, updates, and deletes, not full datasets.

Configure SQL Server On-Premise directly from the UI—select server, database, schema, and table in a guided flow, no scripts required. Crestone can also auto-create schemas and tables during setup, enabling faster pilots and new workloads.

news.title_slide: Full Support for non-Unicode SAP Systems
news.description: Crestone now seamlessly supports non-Unicode SAP systems by auto-detecting the system type and adjusting field lengths using byteLength, ensuring consistent, readable data across all SAP environments.

news.title_slide: New Switch for Data Handling in Destinations
news.description: Control how each destination manages existing data with a new switch: choose between Full Refresh (delete and reload) or Append (add new records). Crestone handles all operations safely in the backend—ideal for snapshots, historical tables, and flexible loading strategies.

180.description: Main new features in this version 1.80.00

news.description: Crestone now supports data extraction through BAPI (Business Application Programming Interface). This allows for structured access to SAP data via remote-enabled function modules, providing more flexibility and control in your integrations.

We've added native support for CDS (Core Data Services) Views, enabling high-performance queries directly on SAP-defined virtual data models. This is ideal for accessing pre-joined and semantically rich datasets from SAP HANA or ABAP.
Crestone now supports File Server as a destination, allowing direct export of datasets to shared drives or local infrastructure environments.

You can now define joins using multiple fields across multiple tables. This enhancement provides more precise data modeling and better alignment with complex data relationships in SAP and other sources.

170.description: Main new features in this version 1.70.00

news.description: A new destination is now available in Crestone: send your data directly to Azure SQL with ease.
You can now extract SAP reports and send them to any of your configured destinations.
Smarter nodes: use Python code to define dynamic dates in your WHERE clauses—no more monthly edits needed.

150.description: Main new features in this version 1.50.00

news.description: We have integrated Azure as a destination, making it easy to store and analyze data in the cloud.
Now you can use Databricks as a destination, optimizing the processing and analysis of large volumes of data.
We have incorporated OData as a new source, allowing data extraction from multiple sources. Compatible with SAP ERP, SAP Business One and SAP ByDesign, ensuring frictionless integration.

Now you can export complete jobs with all their nodes and sequences in a single file, facilitating migration and configuration. This maximizes reusability, reduces implementation times and prevents errors.
